value.rationale: Shannon spacing entropy and large-spacing counts are natural goodness-of-fit statistics. The theorem identifies a unique switch in their dependence for every sample size and gives its sharp rescaled position, a structural fact not implied by knowing only their marginals. It contrasts informatively with quadratic-concentration statistics.
